name: MacBook Pro 13" Intel 2019
commonIssues: Butterfly keyboard failure - Apple Keyboard Service Program eligible (4 years from purchase)
Flexgate - display backlight cable wears through after thousands of open/close cycles
Touch Bar failures (touch input unresponsive, screen freezes, rebooting)
Battery swelling (7 years old in 2026)
Thermal throttling under sustained load - fans ramp aggressively
timelineNotes: Screen 2-3 days. Battery same-day. Top-case (with butterfly keyboard) 1-2 days.
honestyNote: Flexgate is the silent killer of this generation - backlight cable wears through with normal use. We can replace the display assembly (AED 910) but on a 7-year-old machine, the math gets tight. We always show you the numbers before we start.
heroTagline: The last Touch Bar Pro generation. We know its quirks - Flexgate, butterfly, Touch Bar.

name: MacBook Pro 13" Intel 2020
commonIssues: Magic Keyboard (scissor) - much more reliable than 2019
Flexgate still present - display cable wear after years of use
Touch Bar failures
Battery wear at 5+ years
Thermal throttling under load - Intel Core i7 runs hot in this chassis
timelineNotes: Screen 2-3 days. Battery same-day. Keyboard via top-case 1 day.
honestyNote: The last Intel 13" Pro and the first with the reliable scissor keyboard. Battery and keyboard repairs are sensible. If you need a logic board or screen, weigh against a used M1 13" Pro - the performance jump is enormous.
heroTagline: The last Intel 13" Pro. Better keyboard than 2019, still has Flexgate.

name: MacBook Pro 13" M1
display: 13.3" Retina, True Tone, P3, Touch Bar
commonIssues: Battery wear at 4-5 years (very common in 2026)
Touch Bar failures persist (Apple's last Touch Bar laptop)
Magic Keyboard isolated key failures
USB-C / Thunderbolt port damage
Single fan - dust accumulation needs periodic cleaning
timelineNotes: Screen 2-3 days. Battery same-day. Top-case 1 day.
honestyNote: First Apple Silicon Pro and one of our favourite repair targets. Performance is still excellent in 2026. Battery service buys 2-3 more years easily. The last MacBook Pro with the Touch Bar - bittersweet.
heroTagline: The first Apple Silicon Pro. Last of the Touch Bar Pros. Very repair-friendly.

name: MacBook Pro 13" M2
display: 13.3" Retina, True Tone, P3, Touch Bar
commonIssues: 256GB base SSD is single-NAND - slower writes, harder chip-recovery
Touch Bar failures (this is the last MacBook ever with a Touch Bar)
Battery wear starting on early units
Magic Keyboard isolated key failures
USB-C / Thunderbolt port damage from cheap docks
timelineNotes: Screen 2-3 days. Battery same-day. Top-case 1 day.
honestyNote: The final 13" Pro and the very last Mac with a Touch Bar. Apple discontinued the 13" Pro line in October 2023 - the 14" Pro replaced it. Still a great machine. If you have the 256GB base, back up regularly because of the single-NAND SSD.
heroTagline: The last 13" Pro. The last Touch Bar. We service it like a piece of history.
